content_grounding.core_message: A request creates a favour. A schedule creates a default. Giving your partner a named shift is a status upgrade, not charity.
content_grounding.problem_summary: Asking directly for help can feel like an accusation. The partner's one-off gesture resets the expectation: he helped once, so the default remains she owns all of it.
